commands.cmd: systemctl --user is-enabled agentsview-archive.service && systemctl --user is-active agentsview-archive.service && test "$(systemctl --user show -p ExecStart --value agentsview-archive.service | grep -c -- '--require-auth')" = 1 && echo unit_require_auth_flag_present

chk() { r=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$1/"); a=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$1/api/ping"); s=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$1/api/v1/sessions?limit=1"); echo "port=$1 no_token: root=$r api_ping=$a api_sessions=$s"; test "$r" = 200 && test "$a" = 401 && test "$s" = 401; }; chk 17384

chk() { r=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$1/"); a=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$1/api/ping"); s=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$1/api/v1/sessions?limit=1"); echo "port=$1 no_token: root=$r api_ping=$a api_sessions=$s"; test "$r" = 200 && test "$a" = 401 && test "$s" = 401; }; P=17399; if ss -ltn | grep -q "127.0.0.1:$P "; then echo "control port $P busy"; exit 2; fi; T=$(mktemp -d -t av-control.XXXXXX); mkdir -p "$T/home" "$T/data"; HOME=$T/home AGENTSVIEW_DATA_DIR=$T/data AGENTSVIEW_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 AGENTSVIEW_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 agentsview serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port $P --no-sync --no-browser --no-update-check >/dev/null 2>&1 & pid=$!; i=0; until [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:$P/)" = 200 ] || [ $i -ge 60 ]; do sleep 0.5; i=$((i+1)); done; if chk $P; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi; kill $pid; wait $pid 2>/dev/null || true; case "$T" in */av-control.*) rm -rf "$T";; esac; echo "control_without_require_auth_check_exit=$rc"; test "$rc" -ne 0
commands.output_excerpt:
port=17399 no_token: root=200 api_ping=200 api_sessions=200
control_without_require_auth_check_exit=1

commands.cmd: AGENTSVIEW_DATA_DIR=$HOME/.agentsview AGENTSVIEW_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 AGENTSVIEW_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 agentsview projects --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('projects', d) if isinstance(d, dict) else d; print('data_dir_form_projects', len(p)); sys.exit(0 if len(p) > 0 else 1)"

out=$(AGENTSVIEW_DATA_DIR=$HOME/.agentsview AGENTSVIEW_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 AGENTSVIEW_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 agentsview session list --server http://127.0.0.1:17384 --limit 1 --json 2>&1 || true); echo "$out" | grep -o 'HTTP 401: Unauthorized'

claim: On nativestack-5975wx-20260925, agentsview 0.43.0 runs as the enabled, active systemd --user unit agentsview-archive.service with --require-auth in its ExecStart, and the archive's config.toml has one require_auth = true line. Without a token on port 17384, / returned 200 and /api/ping and /api/v1/sessions returned 401. The identical check against an isolated instance started without require_auth (scratch HOME and data dir, port 17399) failed: its API routes returned 200 and the check exited nonzero. With the unit running, the data-dir form of agentsview projects --json listed the archive's projects, and an explicit --server session list without --server-token-file returned HTTP 401.
limitations: Not a reboot or WSL-restart recovery proof; the unit's restart after a host restart is not exercised.
The browser interface's token prompt was not exercised; entering the token is the operator's step.
Which transport the data-dir CLI used is not shown by this output; docs/native-dashboards.md cites it from upstream source.
Only the ordinary dashboard API is covered; the remote-sync, raw-sync and artifact-exchange routes keep their own authentication and were not exercised.
Serves the host's existing default-directory archive with --no-sync; it does not refresh or rescope that archive.
